caption: The drawing features a depiction of a decorative glass goblet. The goblet is shown from the side, centered in the upper portion of the composition, and rendered in pencil or graphite on an off-white or yellowed background. The goblet has an ornate bowl with swirling, raised relief patterns and circular motifs. The stem of the goblet tapers downward, and the foot is square-shaped with a clear, faceted appearance. A horizontal line runs behind the goblet, bisecting the page. Below the goblet, there is a geometric plan view in line drawing, which shows concentric circles nested inside a square, aligned to the goblet's stem and foot, suggesting the base design observed from above. The drawing includes construction lines and a faint vertical axis running through both views, indicating a technical or design study. The colors in the drawing are primarily grayscale, created by the pencils or graphite used, with some shading and hatching present for depth and detail.
title: Lidded Compote
